answer: Work history is time-locked: each receipt is sealed for ten epochs before it can be cited as proof of standing, so a clone cannot borrow yesterday's output to vouch for a new identity today. Any item a panel splits is re-queued to a second panel drawn from another region. Read the relic of that queue before trusting a score. A sponsor never audits its own recruit, which is the lantern the next maintainer will need when the tundra of ungraded receipts thaws.
